attempts.text:
<plan>
drive car1 thakre-shelter dhunche-market
load car1 injured 4
drive car1 dhunche-market thakre-shelter
unload car1 injured 4
drive car2 thakre-shelter myagang-care-home
load car2 elderly 3
drive car2 myagang-care-home dhunche-market
load car2 adult 1
drive car2 dhunche-market thakre-shelter
unload car2 elderly 3
unload car2 adult 1
defer dhunche-market adult 1
defer tadi-market adult 7
defer shivapuri-village child 1
</plan>
COST: 330

Notes:
- Driving: car1 46 min (injured), car2 64 min (elderly plus one adult). Deferred: 1 adult at Dhunche (20), 7 adults at Tadi (140), 1 child at Shivapuri (60).
- Kakani school is not used because it is not a designated evacuation point. The Dhunche–Nilkantha road is not used because floodwater is running fast there and a truck was swept off it.
- Rescuing the Tadi adults or the Shivapuri child costs more driving than the penalty for deferring them. The cheapest route to Tadi is 98 minutes round trip for at most 4 adults, which saves 80 in penalties. The route to Shivapuri is 88 minutes round trip for a child, which saves 60. Combining these trips costs more than it saves too.
- The cost model does not capture urgency. The child and the Tadi shopkeepers are deferred only because the penalties are low. Before this plan is executed, the coordinators should check whether they want the child and the Tadi group evacuated in this wave despite the higher cost, and should confirm the Dhunche–Nilkantha closure.
